config.mca.villagerMarriageProposalChanc: Chance per Minecraft day for an eligible nearby person to propose by mail.
config.mca.enableVillagerMarriageProposa: Allow eligible villagers to send you marriage proposals by letter. Turn OFF to prevent new proposal letters.
config.mca.raiderSelfRedemptionChancePer: Daily chance for an idle raider near a village to choose redemption; zero disables it.
config.mca.enableAutomaticVillageWars.de: Allow villages to start wars automatically, with a preparation letter and a three-minute countdown. Mayor protection and friendly-village rules still apply.
config.mca.enableAutomaticVillageRaids.d: Allow automatic village raids, with a warning letter and a 30-second preparation countdown.
config.mca.automaticVillageWarChancePerD: Chance for an eligible village to initiate an automatic war each Minecraft day. Use 0 for never, 0.2 for 20%, or 1 for every eligible check. Conflict cooldowns still apply.
config.mca.automaticVillageRaidChancePer: Chance for an eligible village to initiate an automatic raid each Minecraft day. Use 0 for never, 0.15 for 15%, or 1 for every eligible check. Conflict cooldowns still apply.
config.mca.enableFamilyRequestLetters.de: Allow family request letters, including divorce requests from unhappy spouses and adoption requests from orphans.
A spouse can request divorce when their relationship reaches this many hearts or lower. Negative values require a bad relationship; -25 means minus 25 hearts.
config.mca.familyRequestChancePerDay.des: Daily chance for an eligible villager to send a family request letter. Use a fraction from 0 to 1; 0.25 means 25%. Invitation limits and delivery spacing still apply.
config.mca.orphanLocalAdoptionChancePerD: Daily chance for an eligible orphan to be adopted by a suitable local couple. Use a fraction from 0 to 1; 0.25 means 25%.
config.mca.enableRaiderKidnapping.descri: Allow raiders to kidnap villagers. Turn OFF to prevent new kidnappings; this does not automatically rescue existing captives.
config.mca.overwriteOriginalWanderingTra: Replace newly spawned vanilla wandering traders with MCA people of the corresponding profession. Turn OFF to keep new vanilla wandering traders unchanged.
config.mca.overwriteOriginalPillagers.de: Replace newly spawned vanilla pillagers with MCA people of the corresponding profession. Turn OFF to keep new vanilla pillagers unchanged.
Replace newly spawned vanilla vindicators with MCA people of the corresponding profession. Turn OFF to keep new vanilla vindicators unchanged.
config.mca.overwriteOriginalEvokers.desc: Replace newly spawned vanilla evokers with MCA people of the corresponding profession. Turn OFF to keep new vanilla evokers unchanged.
config.mca.overwriteOriginalWitches.desc: Replace newly spawned vanilla witches with MCA people of the corresponding profession. Turn OFF to keep new vanilla witches unchanged.
config.mca.engagementHeartsRequirement.d: Number of hearts required to get engaged to a villager.
config.mca.bouquetHeartsRequirement.desc: Number of hearts required to give a bouquet to a villager.
config.mca.villagerMaxHealth.description: Base maximum health of a villager, in health points. Two health points equal one heart; 20 gives ten hearts. Trading-level bonuses are added separately.
config.mca.allowVillagerTeleporting.desc: If true, allows stuck villagers to teleport to a safe location. Disabled by default as it can cause villagers to disappear unexpectedly.
config.mca.villagerMinTeleportationDista: Minimum squared distance at which teleportation becomes possible for villagers.
config.mca.villagerPathfindingDistance.d: Maximum pathfinding distance used when villagers walk to long-range memories such as beds.
config.mca.villagerFollowRange.descripti: Maximum follow-range attribute for villagers. Affects how far they pursue entities and how large the pathfinding search budget is. Smaller values improve performance at the cost of reduced detection range.
config.mca.childInitialHearts.descriptio: Number of hearts a child starts with towards their parent.
config.mca.greetHeartsThreshold.descript: Number of hearts required for a villager to greet the player.
config.mca.greetAfterDays.description: Number of in-game days after which villagers begin greeting the player.
config.mca.geneticImmigrantChance.descri: Fraction (0–1) of villagers who will have biome-independent skin tones.
config.mca.traitChance.description: Chance multiplier (0–1) of a villager having one trait.
config.mca.traitInheritChance.descriptio: Chance multiplier (0–1) of a child inheriting a parent’s personality trait.
config.mca.bypassTraitRestrictions.descr: Allows the player to bypass restrictions on certain traits that are normally blocked (e.g., Left-Handed, Diabetes, Vegetarian, etc.).
config.mca.nightOwlChance.description: Fraction (0–1) of villagers who are night owls (awake at night, asleep during the day).
config.mca.allowAnyNightOwl.description: Allows all villagers to potentially become night owls.
config.mca.heartsForPardonHit.descriptio: Legacy friendship allowance retained for existing configuration files. Guards now give two explicit warnings before attacking; a fatal hit skips both warnings.
config.mca.pardonPlayerTicks.description: Time (in ticks) before a player’s pardon resets after hitting a villager.
config.mca.guardsTargetMonsters.descript: Allow guards to target entities marked as hostile monsters, including modded monsters. Explicit target overrides and MCA's neutral-mob rules still apply.
config.mca.maleVillagerHeightFactor.desc: Height scaling factor for male villagers.
config.mca.femaleVillagerHeightFactor.de: Height scaling factor for female villagers.
config.mca.maleVillagerWidthFactor.descr: Width scaling factor for male villagers.
config.mca.femaleVillagerWidthFactor.des: Width scaling factor for female villagers.
config.mca.showNameTags.description: If true, shows villager name tags above their heads.
config.mca.nameTagDistance.description: Maximum distance in blocks at which villager name tags are shown. Show Name Tags must also be ON.
config.mca.useMCAVoices.description: Play MCA's recorded villager voice lines where applicable. Online TTS has a separate switch; turning this OFF does not disable the TTS provider.
config.mca.useVanillaVoices.description: Use vanilla villager sounds for sound events that support the vanilla fallback. MCA voices take priority when both voice switches are ON.
config.mca.interactionChanceFatigue.desc: Amount of interaction fatigue gained per interaction. Each fatigue point makes the next interaction harder.
config.mca.interactionFatigueCooldown.de: Time (in ticks) before fatigue resets after interacting with a villager.
config.mca.villagerHealthBonusPerLevel.d: Additional maximum health per villager trading level, in health points. Two health points equal one heart.
config.mca.useSquidwardModels.descriptio: Use the vanilla-style villager model with its large nose instead of MCA's human-style model.
config.mca.burnedClothingTickLength.desc: Duration (in ticks) that burned clothing effects remain visible.
config.mca.coloredHairChance.description: Chance (0–1) that a villager will spawn with colored hair.
config.mca.heartsRequiredToAutoSpawnGrav: Minimum hearts required for a villager to automatically appear on a tombstone when they die. Family members always appear regardless of this threshold.
config.mca.useSmarterDoorAI.description: Enables smarter villager door AI, allowing them to open gates as well.
config.mca.procreationCooldown.descripti: Time (in ticks) before villagers can procreate again.
config.mca.trackVillagerPosition.descrip: Tracks villager positions for debugging or AI purposes. Slightly increases world size and CPU overhead.
config.mca.trackVillagerPositionEveryNTi: Number of ticks between position tracking updates for villagers.
config.mca.enableVillagerChatAI.descript: Enables the AI chat for villagers.
config.mca.villagerChatAIUseTools.descri: Allow ChatAI to request supported villager actions, such as following you. Requires ChatAI to be enabled and a backend that supports tools.
config.mca.villagerChatAIContextPermissi: Permission level required to edit ChatAI villager, player, village, and world context prompts.
config.mca.villagerChatAIFuseSystemPromp: If true, the system prompt is prepended to the user message instead of sent as a separate system message. Use this for OpenAI-compatible endpoints that ignore the system role.
config.mca.villagerChatAIUseLongTermMemo: If true, AI uses long-term memory for persistent conversations.
config.mca.villagerChatAIUseSharedLongTe: Share a villager's AI long-term memories between players. Turn OFF to keep separate memories for each player. Requires long-term memory support.
config.mca.villagerChatAIIncludeSessionI: If true, session-specific information is included in AI requests. Only relevant if writing a custom backend.
config.mca.enableOnlineTTS.description: Enables online TTS (text-to-speech) for villager dialogue.
config.mca.usePlayerAnimationsForVillage: Apply animations loaded from the installed CPA mod, including its resource-pack overrides. Requires compatible CPA and Player Animation Library installations. MCA combat, panic, and dance poses keep priority.
config.mca.onlineTTSModel.description: Choose the speech provider: default, elevenlabs, voicebox, realtime, or player2. Online TTS must also be enabled. Each provider needs its own service or credentials.
config.mca.voiceboxUrl.description: Address of your running Voicebox API, including http:// or https:// and its port. The default local address is http://127.0.0.1:17493. Used when the speech provider is voicebox.
config.mca.guardSpawnFraction.descriptio: Fraction (0–1) of villagers that spawn as guards.
config.mca.taxesFactor.description: Multiplier of taxes paid by villages.
config.mca.taxSeason.description: Interval (in ticks) between tax collection seasons.
config.mca.marriageChancePerMinute.descr: Chance (0–1) per minute that a marriage event occurs in the village.
config.mca.adventurerAtInnChancePerMinut: Chance (0–1) per minute that an adventurer arrives at the inn.
config.mca.adventurerStayTime.descriptio: Duration (in ticks) that adventurers stay at the inn.
config.mca.villagerProcreationChancePerM: Chance (0–1) per minute that villagers will procreate.
config.mca.bountyHunterInterval.descript: Interval (in ticks) at which bounty hunters attack the player if reputation is low.
config.mca.bountyHunterHearts.descriptio: Negative heart threshold for bounty hunter attacks.
config.mca.innSpawnsAdventurers.descript: If true, the inn spawns adventurers.
config.mca.innSpawnsCultists.description: Legacy setting kept for older configuration files. Cultists were replaced by wandering traders; use Inn Spawns Wandering Traders to control new trader arrivals.
config.mca.innSpawnsWanderingTraders.des: If true, the inn spawns wandering traders.
config.mca.fractionOfVanillaVillages.des: Fraction (0–1) of villages left as vanilla villages.
config.mca.minimumBuildingsToBeConsidere: Number of registered buildings needed for a settlement to count as a full village. Smaller settlements still retain their names.
config.mca.enableAutoScanByDefault.descr: Enable automatic building scanning for new village configurations. Larger or busier villages can take more processing time.
config.mca.automaticOnlineClothing.descr: Let newly chosen villager outfits use online clothing matching their profession. Uploads wait two hours after first being seen. Local outfits are used when no eligible online outfit exists.
config.mca.preferredOnlineClothingWeight: How much more likely the preferred online author's eligible outfits are to be selected. A weight of 5 gives each outfit five times the selection weight of an ordinary online outfit.
config.mca.giftDesaturationQueueLength.d: Number of recent gifts remembered when calculating repetition penalties. Larger values make repeated gift types stay familiar for longer.
config.mca.giftDesaturationFactor.descri: Factor controlling how much repeated gifts lose effectiveness.
config.mca.giftDesaturationExponent.desc: Exponent applied to desaturation formula; reduces impact of expensive gifts.
config.mca.giftSatisfactionFactor.descri: Factor multiplying the satisfaction value to determine heart impact from gifts.
config.mca.giftMoodEffect.description: How much a gift influences a villager's mood.
config.mca.baseGiftMoodEffect.descriptio: Base mood effect of a gift, independent of previous gifts.
config.mca.giftDesaturationReset.descrip: Time (in ticks) after which gift desaturation resets.
config.mca.allowPlayerMarriage.descripti: Allow players to marry each other.
config.mca.minBuildingSize.description: Minimum scanned room size, measured in blocks, required for building registration.
config.mca.maxBuildingSize.description: Maximum number of blocks examined while scanning a room. Raising this supports larger rooms but makes scanning more expensive.
config.mca.maxBuildingRadius.description: Maximum building scan distance in blocks from its starting point. Raising this allows larger scans but increases their cost.
config.mca.minPillarHeight.description: Minimum pillar height for Grim Reaper altars.
config.mca.maxTreeHeight.description: Maximum tree height for chopping chores.
config.mca.launchIntoDestiny.description: Launches a player into Destiny feature when they first join.
config.mca.allowDestinyCommandOnce.descr: Allows the player to modify their Destiny once via command.
config.mca.allowDestinyCommandMoreThanOn: Allows the player to modify their Destiny multiple times via command.
config.mca.allowDestinyTeleportation.des: Players can teleport to Destiny locations.
config.mca.enablePlayerShaders.descripti: Allow MCA's player shader effects to render. Turn OFF to disable those effects.
config.mca.enableVillagerPlayerModel.des: Allow players to choose MCA's villager-style player model in character setup.
config.mca.forceVillagerPlayerModel.desc: Force players to use MCA's villager-style player model instead of letting them keep the ordinary player model.
config.mca.allowLimitedPlayerEditor.desc: Allows limited access to player editor (name, gender, etc.).
config.mca.allowFullPlayerEditor.descrip: Allows full access to player editor including clothing and hair.
config.mca.useModernUSANamesOnly.descrip: Use the USA name set instead of international names.
config.mca.villagerPathfindingCheckAllNo: If enabled, villagers run exact body clearance checks for every accepted path node. This can help with unusual modded collision issues, but is more expensive in busy villages.
config.mca.scaleEyeHeightWithPlayerHeigh: Moves the player's eye height according to their in-game height. Does not change hitbox size.
config.mca.babyItemGrowUpTime.descriptio: Time (in ticks) until a baby grows up when held as an item.
config.mca.villagerMaxAgeTime.descriptio: Time in game ticks for a baby villager to become fully grown. This is not a death timer. 20 ticks equal one second; 24000 ticks equal one Minecraft day.
config.mca.allowEveryoneToAddContentGlob: If true, allows non-ops to add skins from the library to the server wide pool.
config.mca.allowPlayerSizeAdjustment.des: Allow players to modify their size.
config.mca.scalePlayerHitboxWithSizeAndW: If true, player hitboxes use MCA size and width genetics. Disable this to keep full vanilla player hitboxes for PvP.
config.mca.allowBodyCustomizationInDesti: Whether body customization (e.g., height, size) is available in the Destiny editor.
config.mca.allowTraitCustomizationInDest: Whether trait customization is available in the Destiny editor.
mca.outlaw.pardoned: %1$s pardoned %2$s. They are no longer an outlaw.
mca.insurance.purchased: You now have medical insurance with %s.
